malaria morbidity and mortality rates, other diseases, such as those caused by arboviruses like dengue, 
chikungunya, yellow fever and more recently Zika, are expanding, with an increased number of cases and fatalities. 
It has become evident that the prevention and control of these diseases have to include more than a single 
orientated approach, since the transmission patterns are driven by vector host -pathogens relationship where 
natural conditions, human societies and vector parameters are dynamically interacting.
